author: TeIq
content: Smoke-test #79 discovery against polarislabeler.bsky.social. polaris-publish-did-service authenticates via create_session(app_password) → calls request_plc_operation_signature → bsky.social PDS returns 'Bad token scope'. App-password-issued sessions do not carry the scope PLC operations require; PDSes restrict PLC ops to OAuth sessions or main-password (which would need 2FA handling). Fix: add --oauth path mirroring polaris-publish-labeler-record's recent #61 wiring. Same client-metadata + paste-back URL UX. Until this lands, did:plc identities cannot be smoke-tested end-to-end via the CLI.
